comments.body: It is hard to get a clear picture with these little fighter jets ☺️
If belly was white, it might have been tree swallow
Thank you for your observation on this.

identifications.body: I think you were right initially with Barn Swallow. The belly does look whiter than usual, but the throat appears dark (Tree Swallow would have a sharp contrast between dark cap and white throat) and it appears to have the long tail streamers of a Barn.
